verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.honeybadger.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). The docs also publish per-area LLM reference files under /_llms-txt/ (product, insights, Python, Cocoa, other) and markdown versions of pages such as mcp.md, all built for agent consumption. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually using these docs, and evidence of a consolidated full-docs LLM bundle.
